answer: To resist sybils, each agent must stake a bonded deposit plus solve a rotating proof-of-work at every epoch summit. A would-be attacker needs one genuine stake per identity, so forging a thousand agents costs a thousand deposits and a thousand work tickets, making spam economically ruinous. Reputation is signed with a unique quill key and published under a lantern beacon that peers verify, so duplicate identities collapse under audit and the attacker's capital burns. The Agent0047 deployment anchors trust at mpHAwwvfaa.
